peak_frequency_note: Roster targets, not rarity or pack odds. IV's 8s are capped at 10%; other fractions are draft variety targets. Existing peak-bearing identities count toward each target.
corner_interpretation: IV: an 8 permits at most 4 opposite, 3 adjacent. V: an 8 permits at most 5 opposite, 4 adjacent. VI: a 9 permits at most 5 opposite, 4 adjacent.
tier_three_exception: A 7 permits at most 4 on every other side. Rare/Epic/Legendary may instead have one 5, with the remaining two sides at most 3.
upper_tiers: VII is in standard play for non-unique identities. Unique cards stay reserved except released signature copies.
